en: An old sepia-toned street view postcard depicting a quiet, tree-lined avenue. A few people, including two women and two children, are seen walking or standing in the street. On the left is a building with a sign that reads 'Bahnhof-Hotel.' The background includes classic European-style buildings and a church or tower with a pointed roof. The postcard's bottom text reads 'Hainichen i. Sa. Blick vom Bahnhof in die Wilhelmstr.', suggesting a view from the train station down Wilhelmstrasse.
